title.en: 1.1 Faults, abnormalities and the purpose of protection
title.gu: 1.1 Faults, Abnormalities તથા Protection નો હેતુ

h.en: Faults, abnormalities and the purpose of protection
h.gu: Faults, Abnormalities તથા Protection નો હેતુ

body.en:
Definition

A power-system fault is an unintended electrical connection or interruption that creates an abnormal circuit condition; protection detects defined hazardous conditions and isolates the appropriate part to limit damage and disturbance.

Classification / scope

  • Fault topology: symmetrical/un symmetrical; duration: transient/permanent; condition: short circuit/open conductor/nonfault abnormality.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Shunt faults include LG, LL, LLG and three-phase faults; series faults include one/two open conductors.Three-phase balanced fault is symmetrical; most other faults are un symmetrical.
  • Insulation ageing, lightning, contamination, mechanical damage, animals and human error can cause faults.Overload, underfrequency, overfluxing and unbalance may be abnormalities without an initial short circuit.
  • Consequences include thermal I²t, electro dynamic forces, arc/fire, voltage depression and instability.Protection limits consequences; it does not prevent every initiating fault.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Power-system fault અનિચ્છિત connection અથવા interruption થી abnormal condition ઊભી કરે છે; protection તેને શોધી યોગ્ય ભાગ isolate કરીને damage/disturbance મર્યાદિત કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Topology: symmetrical/un symmetrical; duration: transient/permanent; condition: short/open/nonfault abnormality.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Shunt faults LG, LL, LLG/three-phase; series માં one/two open conductor.Three-phase balanced symmetrical છે; બીજાં મોટા ભાગે un symmetrical.
  • Ageing, lightning, pollution, damage, animals/human error causes છે.Overload, underfrequency, overfluxing/unbalance શરૂઆતમાં short વિના પણ થાય.
  • I²t heat, forces, arc/fire, voltage dip/instability થાય.Protection consequences ઘટાડે, દરેક fault અટકાવતું નથી.

title.en: 1.2 Protection zones, main/backup and essential requirements

h.en: Protection zones, main/backup and essential requirements

body.en:
Definition

A protection zone is the defined primary-system region supervised by a scheme, usually bounded by instrument-transformer locations and associated interrupting devices.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Adjacent zones overlap around breakers to avoid unprotected blind spots; the CT position determines which fault lies inside which zone.
  • Main protection clears its intended fault rapidly/selectively; local breaker failure and independent remote backup address failure of relay, trip circuit or breaker, usually with different scope/delay.
  • Dependability means operating when required; security means not operating un desirably.Reliability needs both, plus selectivity, sensitivity, speed, stability, simplicity and maintainability.
  • Stability includes restraint during external faults or permitted transients.Afast but non selective trip can worsen an otherwise local fault.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Protection zone scheme દ્વારા supervised primary region છે જે સામાન્ય CT locations/associated breakers થી bounded હોય છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Breaker આસપાસ zones overlap કરીને blind spots ઘટાડે; CT position થી internal/external fault નક્કી થાય.
  • Main selective ઝડપી clear કરે; local breaker failure/remote backup relay, trip/CB failure ને જુદા scope-delay થી cover કરે.
  • Dependability જરૂરી વખતે operate/security અનિચ્છિત operation અટકાવે; selectivity, sensitivity, speed, stability/simplicity પણ જોઈએ.
  • Stability માં external fault/permitted transients વખતે restraint; fast non selective trip local fault વધારે ફેલાવી શકે.

title.en: 1.3 Protective CT: ratios, burden and selection
title.gu: 1.3 Protective CT: Ratio, Burden તથા Selection

h.en: Protective CT: ratios, burden and selection
h.gu: Protective CT: Ratio, Burden તથા Selection

body.en:
Definition

A protective current transformer reproduces primary current at a reduced secondary scale with specified accuracy and saturation performance so the protection receives usable fault-current information.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Common rated secondaries are 1 Aor 5A; primary ratio, frequency, continuous current, short-time/peak withstand, insulation, burden and protection class must all match service.
  • For class 5P 20, the composite error limit is 5%at accuracy-limit factor 20 and rated burden under the stated standard conditions; this is not guaranteed transient accuracy for every DC offset.
  • PX-type selection uses excitation/knee-point, winding resistance and other specified data; metering class alone does not establish protective saturation performance.
  • CT lead resistance and relay burden consume voltage capability.Saturation during through faults can create false differential current; use matching, correct polarity and scheme-specific checks.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For ideal CT, KCT=Ip, rated/Is, rated and Is=Ip/KCT.Burden VA≈Is, rated²Zburden.
  2. For 400/1A, KCT=400; 1200 Aprimary gives 3 Asecondary.A 1Ωexternal burden at 1 Arating is 1 VA; at 5 Ait would be 25 VA.

Reliability and safety checks

  • Never open a CT s econdary while primary current flows.Use approved shorting/test blocks and authorised isolation, not improvised loose wires.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Protective CT primary current નું reduced secondary replica specified accuracy/saturation સાથે આપે જેથી fault-current માહિતી ઉપયોગી રહે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Common secondary 1A/5A; primary ratio, f, current withstand, insulation, burden/class બધું service મુજબ.
  • Class 5P 20 માં rated burden/conditions પર ALF 20 એ composite error limit 5%; દરેક DC offset માં transient guarantee નહીં.
  • PX માં excitation/knee-point, Rct/બીજા data; metering class થી protective saturation જાણી નશકાય.
  • Lead/relay burden voltage capability વાપરે; through fault saturation false differential આપે; matching/polarity/checks જરૂરી.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Ideal KCT=Ip, rated/Is, rated; Is=Ip/KCT; burden VA≈Is, rated²Zburden.
  2. 400/1A માં KCT 400; 1200A થી 3A; 1Ωburden 1A એ 1 VA/5A એ 25 VA.

વિશ્વસનીયતા તથા સલામતી

  • Primary current માં CT s econdary open નહીં; approved shorting/test blocks/authorised isolation જ.

h.en: PT/VT and CVT: voltage information and limitations
h.gu: PT/VT તથા CVT: Voltage માહિતી તથા Limits

body.en:
Definition

A protective voltage transformer supplies a reduced, isolated representation of primary voltage for metering, direction, distance and other protection functions.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Inductive VT uses electromagnetic transformation; CVT uses a capacitor divider plus an electromagnetic/intermediate-voltage stage and compensation.CVT is not simply a low-voltage capacitor connected to a relay.
  • Common secondary conventions include 110 Vor 110/√3 Vdepending on line/phase connection; always specify the actual ratio, burden, accuracy, frequency, voltage factor and insulation.
  • VT fuse/MCB failure can make a distance relay appear to see low impedance; supervision must distinguish lost voltage from a fault.CVT transients can affect fast distance reach.
  • An open VT s econdary differs from an open CT s econdary hazard; never short a VT s econdary and respect its protection/earthing scheme.

Worked example / setting interpretation

  1. For 11k V/110 Vline-line ratio, KVT=100.A 6.6k V primary line-line voltage ideally appears as 66 Vsecondary.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Protective VT primary voltage નું reduced isolated representation direction, distance/protection ને આપે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • VT electromagnetic છે; CVT capacitor divider/intermediate transformer/compensation વાપરે; relay ને સીધો capacitor નહીં.
  • Common 110V/110/√3V line/phase પ્રમાણે; actual ratio, burden, accuracy, f, voltage factor/insulation લખો.
  • VT fuse failure low apparent Z આપી શકે; supervision જરૂરી.CVT transients fast distance reach બદલે.
  • VT open/CT open hazards જુદા; VT s econdary short નહીં/approved earthing-protection અનુસરો.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ / Settingનું અર્થઘટન

  1. 11k V/110 Vline-line માં KVT 100; 6.6k V primary થી 66 Vsecondary.

title.en: 1.4 Basic DC tripping circuit and supervision
title.gu: 1.4 Basic DC Tripping Circuit તથા Supervision

h.en: Basic DC tripping circuit and supervision
h.gu: Basic DC Tripping Circuit તથા Supervision

body.en:
Definition

A tripping circuit converts a protection decision into en erg is ation of a breaker trip coil using a dependable auxiliary supply and supervised wiring/conta cts.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • The power system CT/VT s up plies information, not necessarily the energy to move the breaker.Station DC battery/charger supplies trip energy in the chosen scheme.
  • Atypical path is DC+→fuse/MCB→relay trip contact→52a→trip coil→DC−.52a changes with closed breaker state; actual anti-pumping, lockout and supervision diagrams are manufacturer-specific.
  • Trip-circuit supervision checks DC/wiring/coil continuity using designed small currents and auxiliary conta cts; it must not accidentally pick up the trip coil.
  • Fault clearing chain: measure→decide→trip circuit→mechanism→arc interruption.Verify feedback/current extinction rather than assuming a relay LED means the fault is cleared.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Tripping circuit dependable auxiliary supply/conta cts થી protection decision ને CB trip-coil en erg is ation માં ફેરવે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • CT/VT માહિતી આપે, breaker move કરવાની energy જરૂરી નથી; આ scheme માં station DC energy આપે.
  • Typical path DC+→fuse/MCB→relay trip contact→52a→trip coil→DC−; 52a closed state મુજબ; actual lockout/supervision OEM મુજબ.
  • Supervision designed small current/conta cts થી continuity જુએ; અણધાર્યું coil pickup નથવું જોઈએ.
  • Measure→decision→coil→mechanism→arc interruption; LED થી clearance assume નહીં, feedback/current verify કરો.

body.en:
Definition

A protective relay is a measuring/decision device that identifies a specified condition and initiates an assigned alarm, trip or control output.

Classification / scope

  • Technology: electromechanical/static/numerical; quantity: current, voltage, power, impedance, frequency; function: unit/non-unit; timing: instantaneous/definite/inverse.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Pickup is the operating threshold; dropout/reset returns the operated element; reset ratio is commonly dropout/pickup for an overcurrent element, with the manufacturer’s definition stated.
  • Operating time is pickup-to-output under stated test conditions; relay reset time, overshoot and breaker time are separate contributors.
  • PSM=measured operating current/pickup on the same CT side.TMS scales the chosen time curve; it is not a universal delay in seconds.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Protective relay specified condition identify કરી assigned alarm, trip/control output આપતું measuring/decision device છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Technology: electromechanical/static/numerical; quantity: I, V, P, Z, f; function: unit/non-unit; timing: instantaneous/definite/inverse.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Pickup operating threshold/dropout reset છે; OC માં reset ratio સામાન્ય dropout/pickup, definition verify કરો.
  • Operating time stated pickup-to-output; reset, overshoot/CB time જુદાં છે.
  • Same CT side પર PSM=I/Ipickup; TMS chosen curve scale કરે, universal seconds નહીં.

title.en: 1.6 Static relay: elements, merits and limits
title.gu: 1.6 Static Relay: Elements, Merits તથા Limits

h.en: Static relay: elements, merits and limits
h.gu: Static Relay: Elements, Merits તથા Limits

body.en:
Definition

A static relay performs its principal measurement/comparison using electronic circuits without a moving measuring element, although its output may still use moving conta cts.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Conditioning→level/phase comparator→time circuit→output; auxiliary supply and isolation support all stages.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Input isolation/scaling and rectification/filtering feed a comparator/level detector; time-delay circuit and output amplifier/relay create the selected trip action.
  • Level detector compares a signal to a reference; comparator compares amplitudes/phases; time-delay circuit integrates/times the condition; auxiliary supply powers the electronics.
  • Merits: low moving inertia, fast response, low instrument burden and configurable functions.Limits: supply dependence, surge/EMI sensitivity, component drift and diagnostics/repair complexity.
  • Astatic relay is not automatically a numerical relay; analogue signal processing can implement the complete measuring function.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Static relay નું મુખ્ય measurement/comparison electronic છે, measuring element moving નથી; output માં conta cts moving હોઈ શકે છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Conditioning→level/phase comparator→time→output; auxiliary/isolation support.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Input scaling/filter→comparator/level detector→time delay→output amplifier/contact trip આપે.
  • Level detector signal-reference, comparator amplitude/phase compare; delay condition time કરે; auxiliary supply power આપે.
  • Merits: low inertia, fast, low burden/configuration; limits: supply, EMI, drift/repair complexity.
  • Static એટલે numerical જરૂરી નહીં; analogue processing થી measuring function બની શકે.

body.en:
Definition

A numerical relay samples conditioned electrical signals and executes protection algorithms on digital processing hardware to make time-qualified decisions.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • CT/VT input→isolation/scaling→anti-alias filter→sample/hold and ADC→processor/memory→binary output/trip; binary inputs, time source and self-supervision complete the architecture.
  • Facilities may include multiple elements, setting groups, event/SOE logs, disturbance records, metering, self-test, communications and logic; availability varies by model/licence.
  • Compared with static relays, numerical units provide flexible algorithms/records but add firmware, configuration, sampling, cyber security and time-synchronisation risks.
  • Backup settings, control access and test the entire trip chain.Aself-test OK flag does not prove CT polarity, correct settings or breaker operation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Numerical relay conditioned signals sample કરીને digital processor માં algorithms ચલાવી time-qualified decisions લે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Input→scaling→anti-alias→sample/ADC→processor/memory→trip; binary inputs, time/self-supervision પણ છે.
  • Multiple elements, groups, SOE/disturbance, metering, self-test/comms model/licence પ્રમાણે મળે.
  • Static સામે flexibility/records મળે પણ firmware, configuration, sampling/cyber/time risks વધે.
  • Settings backup/access/full chain test; self-test OK થી CT polarity/settings/CB proof નહીં.

title.en: 1.7 Thermal overload relay and thermal memory
title.gu: 1.7 Thermal Overload Relay તથા Thermal Memory

h.en: Thermal overload relay and thermal memory
h.gu: Thermal Overload Relay તથા Thermal Memory

body.en:
Definition

A thermal relay responds to a model or measurement of heating rather than to instantaneous current alone, allowing permissible short-duration overload while preventing sustained thermal damage.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Bi metallic relays use thermal deflection; electronic/numerical relays model heating and may combine RTD s, unbalance and ambient compensation.
  • Thermal overload is not a substitute for fast short-circuit protection.Cooling history/hot restart and actual motor/generator thermal limits affect allowed time.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. A simple first-order model is dθ/dt=(θ∞−θ)/τ, where θis normal is ed temperature rise and θ∞≈(I/In)²under fixed cooling.
  2. For constant current, θ(t)=θ∞+(θ0−θ∞)e^(−t/τ).Trip occurs at a declared model threshold, not a universal machine temperature.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Thermal relay instantaneous current કરતાં heating measurement/model પર કામ કરે; permitted short overload આપે પણ sustained damage અટકાવે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Bimetal deflection વાપરે; electronic/numerical heating model/RTD, unbalance/ambient લે.
  • Thermal relay fast short protection નો વિકલ્પ નહીં; cooling/hot restart/actual thermal limits જોઈએ.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Simple dθ/dt=(θ∞−θ)/τ; θ normal is ed rise/θ∞≈(I/In)²fixed cooling માં.
  2. Constant I માં θ(t)=θ∞+(θ0−θ∞)e^(−t/τ); declared threshold પર trip, universal T નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

An overcurrent relay operates when a measured current exceeds its set threshold with the timing characteristic assigned to that element.

Classification / scope

  • Timing: instantaneous; definite-time(DMT); inverse/ID MT with specified standard-inverse, very-inverse or extremely-inverse curve.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Instantaneous has no intentional coordination delay but still finite measuring/output time; definite-time waits a set delay essentially independent of current above pickup.
  • Inverse-time operates faster as current increases; IDMT is inverse over a range and approaches a minimum/limiting behaviour according to the specific curve/relay.
  • “Time delayed” is a broad category including definite and inverse behaviour; it is not a separate universally identical curve.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For the declared IEC standard-inverse model, t=0.14 TMS/(PSM^0.02−1), PSM>1; below/equal pickup this model has no trip time.
  2. At PSM 10, TMS 0.1, t≈0.2971s.At PSM 5, same TMS, t≈0.4280s.TMS scales time only within the chosen curve.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Overcurrent relay measured I threshold થી વધે ત્યારે assigned timing characteristic પ્રમાણે operate કરે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Timing: instantaneous, DMT, inverse/IDMT સાથે stated SI/VI/EI curve.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Instantaneous માં intentional delay નહીં પણ finite time; definite-time pickup ઉપર set delay આપે.
  • Inverse માં I વધે ત્યારે time ઘટે; IDMT chosen curve/relay પ્રમાણે lower-time behaviour ધરાવે.
  • Time-delayed broad category છે, definite/inverse બંને સમાવી શકે; એક universal curve નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Declared IEC standard-inverse t=0.14 TMS/(PSM^0.02−1), PSM>1; pickup નીનીચે/બરાબર trip time નથી.
  2. PSM 10/TMS 0.1 માં≈0.2971s; PSM 5/same TMS માં≈0.4280s; TMS chosen curve માં જ scale કરે.

body.en:
Definition

Differential protection compares correctly referenced currents entering and leaving a defined zone and operates for sufficient internal imbalance while restraining permitted through current/errors.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • For two terminals with currents defined into the zone, Idiff=|I1+I2|and the declared restraint Irest=(|I1|+|I2|)/2.An external fault ideally has opposite phasors and zero difference.
  • Percentage bias raises the operating threshold with through current, improving stability for CT mismatch/saturation.Adual-slope characteristic may increase restraint at high current.
  • Actual restraint definitions, slopes, breakpoints and high-set unrestrained stages vary; do not copy one vendor setting into another relay.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For the declared one-slope classroom model, operate if Idiff>max(Imin, s Irest), with slope sfractional.
  2. Example: I1=5A, I2=−4.8A gives Idiff 0.2A, Irest 4.9A.With Im in 0.3A, s 0.2, the threshold 0.98 Are strains.
  3. Internal I1=5A, I2=3A gives Idiff 8A, Irest 4A, threshold 0.8 Aand operates in this model.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Differential protection zone માં entering/leaving currents ને proper reference માં compare કરી internal imbalance પર operate/through-current errors સામે restrain કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Into-zone references માં Idiff=|I1+I2|/Irest=(|I1|+|I2|)/2; external માં phasors opposite/Idiffzero.
  • Percentage bias through I સાથે threshold વધારે; CT mismatch/saturation stability સુધારે; dual-slope high I માં વધુ restraint.
  • Restraint/slopes/breakpoints/high-set vendor-specific; settings blindly copy નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Declared model માં Idiff>max(Imin, s Irest), s fraction હોય ત્યારે operate.
  2. I1=5A/I2=−4.8A થી Idiff 0.2A/Irest 4.9A; Imin 0.3A/s 0.2 થી threshold 0.98A/restraint.
  3. Internal I1=5A/I2=3A થી Idiff 8A/Irest 4A/threshold 0.8A/operate.

body.en:
Definition

A directional element identifies the permitted fault/power direction from current and a suitable polarising reference rather than current magnitude alone.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Atypical comparator uses a torque-like quantity proportional to VI cos(θ−MTA), whereθ=arg V−arg Iand MTA is the declared maximum-torque angle.
  • Fault-direction and real-power direction are not interchangeable; fault loop, polarisation, negative/zero sequence and earthing affect directional EF schemes.
  • Directional supervision is combined with pickup/timing; weak/lost polarising voltage or inverter-controlled sequences can invalidate simple angle assumptions.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Directional element current magnitude ઉપરાંત polarising reference થી fault/power ની allowed direction ઓળખે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Typical comparator VI cos(θ−MTA), θ=arg V−arg I/MTA declared angle.
  • Fault direction/real P direction સમાન નહીં; loop, polarisation, sequences/earthing થી EF direction બદલાય.
  • Direction pickup/time સાથે; weak voltage/inverter sequence થી simple angle assumptions ખોટાં થઈ શકે.

h.en: Distance elements: impedance, react ance and ohm
h.gu: Distance Elements: Impedance, React ance તથા Ohm

body.en:
Definition

A distance element measures an appropriate fault-loop impedance from local voltage/current and compares it to a declared reach characteristic on the R–X plane.

Classification / scope

  • Impedance: origin circle; react ance: constant Xline; ohm: general projection line; mho: directional origin-passing circle.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Impedance element |Z|<Zset has a circle centred at origin and is non directional by itself.React ance element X<Xset has a horizontal boundary parallel to the Raxis and needs appropriate supervision.
  • Classical ohm element measures a projection Rcosψ+Xsinψ<K; a straight line forms its boundary.React ance is the ψ90°special case, not a second name for the impedance circle.
  • Distance is inferred from line impedance, not measured as geographical kilometres without line/CT/VT data.Aground loop needs the correct residual compensation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Distance element local V/I થી proper fault-loop impedance મેળવી R–Xplane માં declared reach સાથે compare કરે છે.

Definition

A simple self-polarised mho element has a circular operating characteristic passing through the R–X origin and its forward reach point, with direction inherent in its ideal comparator.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • For reach vector Zr, the ideal circle centre is Zr/2 and radius|Zr|/2; operation lies inside with the selected supervision.Boundary behaviour/tolerances must be declared in tests.
  • It is not an origin-centred circle—that is the plain impedance element.Memory/cross-polarisation and modern quadrilateral schemes change practical behaviour.
  • Load encroachment, power swings, arc resistance, CVT transients and weak infeed must be checked before applying reach settings.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For Zr=6+j 8Ω, centre=3+j 4Ωand radius 5Ω.Z=3+j 4Ωis inside; Z=−3−j 4Ωis outside.

Definition

An auxiliary relay extends, isolates, latches or repeats a protection/control decision without necessarily measuring the original fault quantity.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Interposing relays match contact duties/isolation; lockout 86 latches a serious trip until authorised reset; trip multiplication can operate several breaker coils.

body.en:
Definition

An individual survey identifies real switchgear functions, verified ratings and standard drawing symbols without unsafe access.

Classification / scope

Working / operating sequence

  1. Plan safe scope and cite the source/materials; prepare SLD or logic before any approved isolated mock assembly.
  2. Review the result against function, selectivity, safety, evidence and stated limitations; submit only genuine completed work.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • List CB, disconnector, earth switch, fuse, CT, VT/CVT, relay and arrest er; distinguish interruption, isolation, measurement and surge functions.

  • Draw the symbol and an example SLD location; cite permitted source/manual and explain one selection issue and one maintenance/safety concern per equipment family.

h.en: Project 4 · Group: Basic tripping circuit mock model

body.en:
Definition

A basic trip-circuit project is a group-built isolated low-energy logic model that replaces a power breaker/trip coil with indicators and a simulated state.

Classification / scope

  • Source group project; mock-only construction.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Plan safe scope and cite the source/materials; prepare SLD or logic before any approved isolated mock assembly.
  2. Review the result against function, selectivity, safety, evidence and stated limitations; submit only genuine completed work.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Use an isolated current-limited supply not exceeding 24 VDC, fuse/limited indicator load and approved instructor layout.No station battery, actual HV breaker or mains-powered exposed wiring.
  • Draw source→fuse→trip contact→simulated 52a→lamp/logic load→return; use separate reset/close permission and latch the simulated open state.
  • Create a truth table for healthy, trip, open-fuse, loss-supply and stuck-command cases; record actual low-energy measurements only if built, otherwise label all results simulated.
  • Check that lamp going dark can mean loss of supply rather than successful isolation.Amock contact indication is not proof of an actual circuit being dead.

Definition

A source-listed learning activity with a structured evidence guide; completion is not pre-certified.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Select an authorised safe topic/source and define questions.
  2. Collect verifiable evidence, prepare an original diagram, and distinguish source facts from your interpretation.
  3. Conclude with protection lessons, limitations and viva discussion; use the length needed, no invented mandatory page count.

q.en: Why must a live CT s econdary never be opened?
q.gu: Live CT secondary કેમ open ન કરવી?

a.en: Primary current can sustain core flux while the secondary loses its counter-magnetising current, creating dangerously high secondary voltage, heating and residual magnetism.Use approved make-before-break shorting/test blocks under authority.
a.gu: Primary current ચાલુ હોય ત્યારે secondary counter-flux ઘટવાથી dangerous voltage, heat અને residual magnetism થઈ શકે.Approved make-before-break test block જ વાપરો.

a.en: For the stated standard and rated burden, it denotes a protection CT with 5%composite error limit at accuracy-limit factor 20.It does not guarantee transient accuracy for every asymmetric fault.
a.gu: Stated standard/rated burden પર ALF 20 ખાતે 5%composite-error limit છે; દર asymmetric transient માં accuracy guarantee નથી.

q.gu: Main તથા backup protection માં તફાવત?

a.en: Main protection clears faults in its assigned zone first.Backup operates if the main/associated breaker path fails and may be slower or less selective; local and remote backup have different dependencies.
a.gu: Main પોતાના zone માં પહેલાં fault clear કરે.Backup main/breaker path નિષ્ફળ જાય ત્યારે કાર્ય કરે; local/remote dependencies જુદાં છે.

q.en: Is a numerical relay just a static relay?
q.gu: Numerical relay માત્ર static relay છે?

a.en: Both use electronics, but a numerical relay samples inputs and executes configurable algorithms in a processor.Static relays mainly use analogue/electronic comparator and timing circuits; either still needs reliable inputs, power and output logic.
a.gu: બંને electronic છે, પણ numerical ADC/processor algorithms વાપરે છે; static મુખ્યત્વે analogue comparator/timer વાપરે છે.બંનેને reliable inputs, aux power/output જોઈએ.

a.en: It raises required differential current with restraint current to improve security against ratio errors and external-fault CT mismatch.CT s atu ration and inrush may still require additional scheme-specific measures.
a.gu: Through/restraint current વધતાં operating threshold વધે એટલે ratio/CT mismatch સામે stability સુધરે; inrush/saturation માટે અલગ measures જોઈએ.

q.en: Difference between impedance and mho characteristics?
q.gu: Impedance તથા mho characteristic નો તફાવત?

a.en: Ideal impedance is a circle centred at the origin and is not inherently directional.Ideal mho passes through the origin with centre at half the reach vector; actual relay polarisation/supervision affects behaviour.
a.gu: Impedance origin-centred/non-directional circle છે; mho origin માંથી પસાર થાય અને centre reach-vector ના અડધે છે; actual polarisation મહત્વનું છે.

a.en: It means no intentional time delay.The measuring element, output contact, trip circuit and breaker still require finite time.
a.gu: Intentional delay નથી એવો અર્થ છે; measurement, output/trip/CB ને ખરેખર finite સમય લાગે છે.

q.en: What does an auxiliary relay add?

a.en: Contact multiplication, interposing, seal-in, lockout or supervision according to design.It is not necessarily an independent measuring protective element and contact duty/reset rules must match the application.
a.gu: Design મુજબ contact multiplication, interposing, latch/lockout/supervision આપે છે; તે હંમેશા અલગ measuring element નથી; contact duty/reset યોગ્ય જોઈએ.
